name: Pencil mark
what: A hand-drawn mark over your video - a circle round something, an underline, an arrow, a check, a cross or a scribble - drawn stroke by stroke by a pencil whose tip rides the line, with an optional handwritten note; then the pencil lifts away.

learned_from.what: a pencil drawing a long curve, its tip following the line

motion: the strokes draw over 18 f (S-curve each), the tip on the line every frame; the note wipes in 12 f; the pencil lifts 10 f (accelerating)
